issues.issue: Unexplained local receipts are 42.8% of the year's receipts (19,174.21 of 44,753.77) and more than double the prior year (8,978.85). The form says nothing about what they are; for a cemetery district they are probably lot sales and burial fees (charges for services/fees). 'other' with review follows the rules, but the governmental 'other' share is far above 10%.
